annotations.title: Get the signed settlement statement of a case

description: Get the signed settlement statement of a case: its state (open, acknowledged, hold_period, settleable, fully_reversed, result_not_verified), evidence level, net amount and the receipts. The state is derived from the receipts by published rules you can re-run offline (attribution_verify.py). 'settleable' and 'verified' mean only that the signed events meet those rules; they do not mean the sale happened, that a commission is owed or that anyone will pay. Free.
name: attribution_statement
title: Get the signed settlement statement of a case
